# astro-iconset

> Build-time SVG icon integration for Astro. Use local `.svg` files, Iconify sets (`@iconify-json/*`), per-file `?icon` imports, automatic sprites, and SVGO optimization — with **zero icon runtime shipped to the browser**. Also provides framework adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Preact, and Solid.

**Important:** `astro-iconset` is a distinct, modern package — **not** the older `astro-icon`. It is a superset: everything `astro-icon` does, plus `?icon` SVG imports, framework adapters, named prefix directories (`iconDirs`), and an SSR `include` filter. Install with `npx astro add astro-iconset` and import the component from `astro-iconset/components`.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/astro-iconset
- GitHub: https://github.com/sudeep2003/astro-iconset
- Full docs (single file): https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/llms-full.txt

## Start

- [Overview](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/): what the package does and its full surface area.
- [Getting Started](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/getting-started/): install, register the integration, render your first icon, quick reference.
- [Features](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/features/): every feature with examples, plus a comparison table vs astro-icon.

## Guides

- [Local & Iconify icons](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/customization/): naming rules, `iconDir`, `iconDirs`, mixing local and Iconify sets.
- [SVG imports (?icon)](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/icon-imports/): import a single `.svg` with `?icon` and pass `icon={…}`.
- [Components](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/components/): `Icon` props, sprites, and `is:inline`.
- [Framework islands](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/frameworks/): `astro-iconset/react`, `/vue`, `/svelte`, `/preact`, `/solid`.
- [CSS & styling](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/styling/): `data-icon`, `currentColor`, Tailwind, accessibility.
- [Deployment & SSR bundles](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/deployment/): the `include` filter for server/hybrid output.
- [Troubleshooting](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/guides/troubleshooting/): icon not found, wrong size/color, TypeScript `?icon` errors, SSR issues.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://astro-iconset.wingflows.com/reference/configuration/): all integration options — `include`, `iconDir`, `iconDirs`, `svgoOptions`, `dataAttr` — with types and defaults.
